## Library
```{r}
# Library of Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(stars)
library(tmap)
library(quarto)
library(spData)
library(spDataLarge) 
library(geodata) 
```

## Set Theme
```{r}
# Set Theme
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

# Prepare Data

## Data Loading (needed for function)
```{r}
# EEZ shapefile
eez <- sf::st_read(
  'data/wc_regions_clean.shp',
  quiet = TRUE
)

# Ocean depth raster
depth <- rast('data/depth.tif')

# Sea Surface Temperature rasters (2008-2012)
sst <- rast(c(
  'data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif',
  'data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif',
  'data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif',
  'data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif',
  'data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif'
))
```

## Checking CRS
```{r}
if (st_crs(eez) == st_crs(depth) && st_crs(eez) == st_crs(sst)) {
  print('ALL CRS MATCH')
} else {
  warning('AT LEAST ONE CRS DOES NOT MATCH')
}

print(crs(eez, describe = TRUE))
print(crs(depth, describe = TRUE))
print(crs(sst, describe = TRUE))
```

# Process Data (needed for function)
```{r}
# Raster of mean SST from 2008-2012
sst_mean <- mean(sst, na.rm = TRUE)

# Converting values from K to C
sst_mean_c <- sst_mean - 273.15

# Cropping depth to sst extent
depth_cropped <- crop(depth, sst_mean_c)
depth_cropped[depth_cropped == 32767] <- NA # correcting any NA values

# Resampling depth for resolution match
depth_resampled <- resample(depth_cropped, sst_mean_c, method = 'bilinear')

# Converting land elevations to NA
bathymetry <- depth_resampled
bathymetry[bathymetry > 0] <- NA
```

```{r}
# Check for elevations in bathymetry
if ((max(values(bathymetry), na.rm = TRUE)) < 0) {
  print('ALL VALUES OF DEPTH')
} else {
  warning('STILL INCLUDES ELEVATION VALUE(S)')
}

# Checking for matching CRS, resolution, and extent simultaneously
if (
  compareGeom(
    sst_mean_c,
    bathymetry,
    lyrs = FALSE,
    stopOnError = FALSE,
    messages = TRUE
  ) ==
    TRUE
) {
  print('EVERYTHING MATCHES')
} else {
  warning('SOMETHING DOES NOT MATCH')
}
```

```{r}
# If simultaneous check returns warning:
# Checking for matching CRS
if (st_crs(sst_mean_c) == st_crs(bathymetry)) {
  print('CRS MATCH')
} else {
  warning('CRS DOES NOT MATCH')
}

# Checking for matching resolution
if (all(res(sst_mean_c) == res(bathymetry))) {
  print('RESOLUTION MATCH')
} else {
  warning('RESOLUTION DOES NOT MATCH')
}

# Checking for matching extent
if (ext(sst_mean_c) == ext(bathymetry)) {
  print('EXTENT MATCH')
} else {
  warning('EXTENT DOES NOT MATCH')
}
```

## Find Suitable Locations for OYSTERS
```{r}
# Reclassify depth
bathymetry_matrix <- matrix(
  c(
    -70, 0, 1,
    -9999, -70, 0,
    0, 9999, 0
  ),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)

bathymetry_reclass <- classify(
  bathymetry,
  bathymetry_matrix,
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  right = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# Plotting suitable oyster depths, note: contains terrestrial/freshwater depths below sea level
plot(bathymetry_reclass,
     mar = c(5, 3, 2, 4),
     main = 'Suitable Oyster Depths',
     xlab = 'Longitude',
     ylab = 'Latitude',
     font.main = 2,
     font.lab = 2,
     font.axis = 2,
     cex.main = 1.5,
     cex.lab = 1.2,
     cex.axis = 1.4,
     plg = list(title = 'Suitability',
                title.font = 2,
                title.cex = 1.3,
                legend = c('Unsuitable (0)', 'Suitable (1)')))
```
```{r}
# Reclassify SST
sst_matrix <- matrix(
  c(
    -9999, 11, 0,
    11, 30, 1,
    30, 9999, 0
  ),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)

sst_reclass <- classify(
  sst_mean_c,
  sst_matrix,
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  right = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
# Plotting suitable oyster temperatures, note: contains some terrestrial/freshwater values
plot(sst_reclass,
     mar = c(5, 3, 2, 4),   
     main = 'Suitable Oyster Sea Surface Temperature',
     xlab = 'Longitude',
     ylab = 'Latitude',
     font.main = 2,
     font.lab = 2,
     font.axis = 2,
     cex.main = 1.5,
     cex.lab = 1.2,
     cex.axis = 1.4,
     plg = list(title = 'Suitability',
                title.font = 2,
                title.cex = 1.3,
                legend = c('Unsuitable (0)', 'Suitable (1)')))
```

```{r}
# Locations satisfying both SST and depth conditions
depth_sst_suitable <- lapp(
  sds(bathymetry_reclass, sst_reclass),
  fun = function(c_sst, c_bath) {
    as.numeric(c_sst == 1 & c_bath == 1)
  }
)
```

```{r}
# Plotting suitable depth and temperature for oysters
plot(depth_sst_suitable,
     mar = c(5, 3, 2, 4),   
     main = 'Suitable Oyster Sea Surface Temperature AND Depth',
     xlab = 'Longitude',
     ylab = 'Latitude',
     font.main = 2,
     font.lab = 2,
     font.axis = 2,
     cex.main = 1.5,
     cex.lab = 1.2,
     cex.axis = 1.4,
     plg = list(title = 'Suitability',
                title.font = 2,
                title.cex = 1.3,
                legend = c('Unsuitable (0)', 'Suitable (1)')))
```

## Determine the Most Suitable EEZ for OYSTERS
```{r}
# Checking for matching CRS
if (st_crs(eez) == st_crs(depth_sst_suitable)) {
  print('CRS MATCH')
} else {
  warning('CRS DO NOT MATCH')
}
```

```{r}
# Make eez data a raster
eez_rast <- rasterize(eez, depth_sst_suitable, field = 'rgn')
```

```{r}
# Find cell size
cell_size <- cellSize(depth_sst_suitable, unit = 'km', mask = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Use only suitable cells
suitable <- mask(cell_size, depth_sst_suitable, maskvalues = 0)
```

```{r}
# Suitable area per EEZ region
suitable_per_eez <- zonal(suitable, eez_rast, fun = 'sum', na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Join EEZs with suitable oyster area per EEZ
oyster_map <- left_join(eez, suitable_per_eez, by = 'rgn')
```

```{r}
# Mapping oyster suitablility by EEZ
tm_shape(oyster_map) + 
  tm_basemap('Esri.WorldGrayCanvas') + 
  tm_polygons(fill = 'area', 
            fill.legend = tm_legend(title = expression("Suitable Area (km"^2*")"), 
                                    position = tm_pos_in('right', 'CENTER'),
                                    title.size = 0.7,
                                    text.size = 0.7,
                                    item.height = 0.6,
                                    item.width = 0.6,
                                    padding = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2))) + 
  tm_title(str_wrap(paste('Suitable Oyster Habitat by EEZ Region on the US Pacific Coast'), 
                    width = 15), 
           size = 1, 
           position = tm_pos_in(pos.h = 0.95, 
                                pos.v = 0.7, 
                                just.h = 'right', 
                                just.v = 'center'),
           fontface = 'bold') +
  tm_text(text = 'rgn', size = 0.6) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c('RIGHT', 'top'),
              text.size = 0.5) +
  tm_compass(type = 'arrow', 
             position = tm_pos_in('left', 'top'),
             size = 1.5)
```

# Function for Mapping Suitable Area for Mariculture
```{r}
suitable_habitat <- function(min_temp_c, max_temp_c, min_depth_neg, max_depth_neg, species_name) {
  # Reclassify depth
bathymetry_matrix <- matrix(
  c(
    min_depth_neg, 9999, 0,
    max_depth_neg, min_depth_neg, 1,
    -9999, max_depth_neg, 0
  ),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)

bathymetry_reclass <- classify(
  bathymetry,
  bathymetry_matrix,
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  right = TRUE
)

# Reclassify SST
sst_matrix <- matrix(
  c(
    -9999, min_temp_c, 0,
    min_temp_c, max_temp_c, 1,
    max_temp_c, 9999, 0
  ),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)

sst_reclass <- classify(
  sst_mean_c,
  sst_matrix,
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  right = TRUE
)

# Locations satisfying both SST and depth conditions
depth_sst_suitable <- lapp(
  sds(bathymetry_reclass, sst_reclass),
  fun = function(c_sst, c_bath) {
    as.numeric(c_sst == 1 & c_bath == 1)
  }
)

# Make eez data a raster
eez_rast <- rasterize(eez, depth_sst_suitable, field = 'rgn')

# Find cell size
cell_size <- cellSize(depth_sst_suitable, unit = 'km', mask = TRUE)

# Use only suitable cells
suitable <- mask(cell_size, depth_sst_suitable, maskvalues = 0)

# Suitable area per EEZ region
suitable_per_eez <- zonal(suitable, eez_rast, fun = 'sum', na.rm = TRUE)

# Join EEZs with suitable area per EEZ
map <- left_join(eez, suitable_per_eez, by = 'rgn')

# Mapping suitablility by EEZ
tm_shape(map) + 
  tm_basemap('Esri.WorldGrayCanvas') + 
  tm_polygons(fill = 'area', 
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = expression("Suitable Area (km"^2*")"), 
                                      position = tm_pos_in('right', 'CENTER'),
                                      title.size = 0.7,
                                      text.size = 0.7,
                                      item.height = 0.6,
                                      item.width = 0.6,
                                      padding = c(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1))) + 
  tm_title(str_wrap(paste('Suitable', 
                          species_name, 
                          'Habitat by EEZ Region on the US Pacific Coast'), 
                          width = 20), 
            size = 0.75, 
            position = tm_pos_in(pos.h = 0.95, pos.v = 0.7, just.h = 'right', just.v = 'center'),
            fontface = 'bold') +
  tm_text(text = 'rgn', size = 0.6) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c('RIGHT', 'top'),
              text.size = 0.5) +
  tm_compass(type = 'arrow', 
             position = tm_pos_in('left', 'top'),
             size = 1.5)
}
```

# Example: Panopea generosa (Pacific Geoduck) 
Suitable Conditions: Depth = 3-20 m, Temperature = 8-18 degrees C
```{r}
suitable_habitat(8, 18, -3, -20, 'Panopea generosa')
```
